Argylebuild/ML2-Installer.name: Argyle Build for Magic Leap 2 v2.3.0
Argylebuild/ML2-Installer.body:
## What's New

- MFA on all platforms
- Google SSO on all platforms
- position scramble fixed on Revit exports
- geolocation bug fixed in Navisworks
- New UI in AR apps
- First version of progress tracker
- Geolocation via shared project with gps device. Usable as rough location and gives geolocation of spatialized data (like AR photos)
- RYO anchors are shared again. Only manager and above can upload.

## Changes since v2.2.2

- ml2 ui scaling (6b00b42)
- cicd changes (90b3a08)
- cicd changes for fewer failures and easier retries (3281162)
- testing 2.3.0 (1d598d7)
- ui fixes (b55b6c3)
- imported major updates for react ui from ios. Not tested in device yet. (cdd7849)
- showed IPS and got notes (814c65f)
- Added basic React for Unity infrastructure. Tested in device. Success. (9031509)
- Add ReactUnity core + QuickJS packages for the code-authored UI spike (b3f6568)

Argylebuild/Revit-Installer.name: Argyle Revit Plugin v2.2.0
Argylebuild/Revit-Installer.body:
## What's New

# Release Notes - v2.0.6

- **Improved Project Management**: The user interface now hides projects you don't have write access to, reducing confusion and streamlining project selection
- **Enhanced CAD Import**: Added comprehensive line handling and improved support for CAD file imports
- **Better Data Export**: Texture support now included in exports, providing more complete model representation
- **Bug Fixes**: Resolved issues with duplicate API data and improved compatibility with older project manifests

## Changes since v2.0.5

- Matching navis in submodule (1578bea)
- Dedicated revit signer (087d837)
- fixed doubles in api data (b1b337a)
- old bug fix. Still testing textures (8648bc4)
- added texture to export (c1b8047)
- lines round 2 for CAD import added. (b7669f9)
- added line handling (0abb308)
- updating to latest (deb889b)
- preventing error from confusing old manifests (5379a5f)
- Bump actions/checkout from 6 to 7 (068bd7b)
- user interface no longer lists project that can't be written to (8f32485)

Argylebuild/Navisworks-Installer.name: Argyle Navisworks Add-in v2.3.0
Argylebuild/Navisworks-Installer.body:
## What's New

# Release Notes v2.3.0

- **Enhanced Security**: Two-factor authentication (2FA) and Google Login now available for improved account protection
- **Improved Performance**: Optimized geometry caching and mesh handling for faster processing of complex models
- **Better Model Export**: Fixed sparse export functionality to ensure complete and reliable file output

## Changes since v2.2.1

- updated the api consumer to match latest (9d15b41)
- Free the geometry cache after each partition; document the oversized-mesh fix (aceb716)
- Split oversized element meshes into several primitives; upload every written .bin (e3a5c76)
- caught up to same code backends (a5f466b)
- 2fa and google loging added. 2fa successfully tested. (ef3c376)
- build dev and prod both and put them in private release (02144c0)
- cicd with automated signing (6d97367)
- Setup 2027 (768963d)
- added model pipeline roadmap docs (86130cf)
- sparse export fix tested. looking pretty good. (2d09728)
